info.title: Emukey API
info.description: Versioned API for the Emukey license platform

expectedCurrentVersion.description: Observed current version; 0 means no published version.

renewalStatus.description: Latest RENEW_LICENSE command status for this exact order, not the original issuance.

renewalExpiresAt.description: Target expiry of this renewal; effective only after canonical chain confirmation.

estimatedExpiresAt.description: Estimate only; final expiry uses verified payment time.

providerOccurredAt.description: Timestamp reported by the payment provider.

licenseId.description: License id for device-bound entitlement or revoke challenges; not required for activation.

activationKey.description: Required for activation challenges; used to resolve the license without customer ownership.

deviceId.description: Set when requesting a challenge to revoke an existing device

licenseId.description: Resolved license id; returned only after the activation credential has been accepted.

activationKey.description: Bearer activation credential supplied by the enterprise administrator

devicePublicKey.description: EVM address corresponding to the device signing key

proof.description: EIP-191 signature over the activation challenge
EIP-191 signature over the revoke challenge
EIP-191 device signature over the entitlement challenge

token.description: Signed entitlement JWT returned by issue or refresh
